files.rationale: Took PR B's root layout, since its SearchProvider, Header, ProgressBar (NProgress) and GoogleTagManager already cover what PR A's Providers/gtag-script layout did, and PR B also carries the full site metadata; layering both would double-wrap the search context and double-load analytics.
Took PR B's server-component homepage because PR A's version re-exports '../pages/index', and PR B deletes the pages directory, so that import would break after the merge.
Combined PR A's typed nextConfig object and experimental appDir flag with PR B's MDX options and its 'jsx' page extension.

Merged the dependency upgrades by taking the newer version from either side (PR B's MDX v3, husky 9, image-size 1.1.1, lint-staged 15.2.1 and @next/third-parties), kept next ^14.1.0, PR A's prettier/shell-quote dev upgrades, and PR B's packageManager field.
